# The hottest storefront in the world has a doorman. Your products aren’t on the list.

When a shopper sends an AI to buy, the agent works from a clipboard. The list is structured product data. Names on it walk straight in. Names with missing details get held back before you even know the shopper was there. Products with incomplete data aren't ranked lower. They aren't considered at all. Upload your catalog and watch, name by name, the sale that happens without you.

Every product below was turned away at the rope. Right products, right price, just not on the list. No argument, no appeal. The night’s spending walked in with someone else.

### Join the waitlist for catalog repair.

Leave your email and we'll add you to the catalog repair waitlist. When it's ready, your broken products get fixed automatically and you get back a clean file to re-import.
